Package org.example.view

Class PizzaVisualisation

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.canvas.Canvas
org.example.view.PizzaVisualisation
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget, IVisualisation
public class PizzaVisualisation extends javafx.scene.canvas.Canvas implements IVisualisation
Custom JavaFX Canvas component rendering dynamic 2D animations of the pizzeria simulation.

Implements IVisualisation to visually move customer sprites along station path waypoints, manages sprite queuing logic for capacity-constrained service points (ovens, dining tables, couriers), handles image assets loading, and runs an asynchronous JavaFX UI animation thread.

Version:
3.0
Author:
Anja, Niklas, Illia
